title: 5b-5: concept density metric
description:
## Parent

sutra/44 (5b PRD: component discovery + vocabulary)

## What to build

Compute concept density per component as a review-prioritization signal. v1 metric from Layer 0 data: `(unique_symbol_kinds × naming_stem_diversity) / LOC`. High density = conceptually varied code needing more review attention. Low density = repetitive handlers, lighter review. Store per component, include in component listing output.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concept density computed as (unique_symbol_kinds × naming_stem_diversity) / LOC per component
- [ ] Naming stem diversity extracted from symbol names (strip common prefixes/suffixes, count unique stems)
- [ ] Density included in sutra_components output
- [ ] Test: known symbol distribution → expected density score (high for diverse, low for repetitive)

## Blocked by

- sutra/45 (5b-1: basic component discovery)

messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial, tasks 49/50/51):

- [medium] Concept density is computed from anchor-only subset, not all symbols in the component. Drops kinds like module, impl, macro, class, mixin.
- [medium] Stem extraction does not strip common prefixes/suffixes as specified in AC. Shared tokens like 'handle' inflate diversity."
